anya: Small Python v2 snippet showing batch + kv_prefetch:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='$REDWOOD')
outs = c.batch.text.generate([{'model':'redwood/opt-lite','prompt':'Summarize logs'},{'model':'redwood/opt-lite','prompt':'List errors'}], options={'kv_prefetch': True})
for o in outs: print(o.text)
```
